title: TS-69 Handoff step 5: cutover
description:
Source: the Pi session handoff spike (PR 474: spikes/pi-handoff, docs/PI_HARNESS.md section 'Spike: handoff to a computer owner', GO in steps) and docs/PI_SESSION_HANDOFF.md. Decision (user): the goal is a Pi session running in the computer container, using Pi's own tools (read, write, edit, bash from @earendil-works/pi-durable/tools), with the session portable between owners. Security gate before production: the container must not hold the model key or broad storage credentials.

After the live rehearsal passes: delete the remote host-protocol executors and the park-and-claim tool path for computers we own (customer-account computers keep the HTTP host protocol and never get Pi), remove edit_workspace if superseded by Pi's edit, run the conformance and handoff scenarios in CI, update docs/PI_SESSION_HANDOFF.md from proposal to built, and the README.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged: phase 1 PR 486 (browse and request_computer_capability answer not-available at once on the owner path; one owner per computer pinned by a scenario; a losing owner now persists nothing, which was a real bug), phase 2 PR 487 (runtime switch, own-account host start and four dead domain functions removed; 8 scenarios deleted), docs PR 488 (handoff doc, two Archify diagrams, README and architecture docs). Post-cutover smoke on development passed. Left: remove the own-account host task definition and service from the Computers stack (re-source the cluster and network outputs first; deploy by hand), TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE 4.1 and 4.3 still read as host-worker design, staging and production promotion (separate project). Customer-account computers keep the host worker permanently (decision 3).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Triage 2026-10-14: closing as done; the leftovers named in the earlier comment have their own tickets. Evidence: PR 486, PR 487 (runtime switch; own-account host start and four dead domain functions removed; 8 scenarios deleted), PR 488 (handoff doc, README, architecture docs); conformance and handoff scenarios run in CI (features/computer_owner_handoff.feature in features/cucumber-features.txt); docs/PI_SESSION_HANDOFF.md and README describe the path as built and proven live on development, and customer-account computers keep the host protocol on purpose (decision 3). Remaining items live elsewhere: Computers stack host task removal is chatticus-35535d, TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE 4.1 and 4.3 is chatticus-7366ff. Staging and production promotion of the owner path is a separate project and is not tracked by this ticket; the README says explicitly that staging and production do not run it.

right_now_summary: The Pi handoff path is built and proven in development; remaining cleanup and promotion are tracked elsewhere.
